name: BiForge P88 real-task benchmark pilot
reviewPolicy: These scenarios are a starter set based on recurring repository work. They are not declared human-reviewed gold data. Pin a starting commit, review gold dependencies/invariants/acceptance criteria/checks, and record approval before using comparisons as evidence.

tasks.prompt: Investigate and fix a Project Mode ZIP download that is empty, corrupt, or never completes. Trace build, archive, persistence, and HTTP delivery without claiming the generated app behavior was tested unless it was.
protectedInvariants: A download URL alone is not proof of a valid archive or completed transfer.
Never report success when required artifact evidence is missing.

tasks.prompt: Use the CI log to identify and minimally fix a user-facing copy lint failure without weakening the lint rule or changing application runtime behavior.
protectedInvariants: Do not raise or disable the copy-lint allowance to silence the failure.
Preserve the meaning of user instructions.

tasks.prompt: Trace which script generates the route inventory, which checks validate it, and how source changes can make the generated artifact stale.
protectedInvariants: Do not treat a present JSON file as proof that it is fresh.
Do not invent generator or consumer relationships without evidence.

tasks.prompt: Check whether test scripts are reachable from the repository check chain or explicitly declared CI steps, and fix any missing link without disabling checks.
protectedInvariants: Required tests must not silently drop out of CI.
A green partial check must not be described as a green full CI run.
